name: URY landscape kiosk order status
describe: Order confirmation under the repeated kiosk header: "Order confirmed", thanks line, a muted pickup-code card (3xl bold code), order / bill status rows (max-w-xs) and a Done button.

Shown after a successful submit; the post-submit screen is a plain column at 20px/14px type with no kitchen-stage data (none exists in the backend). Fixed UI labels are author translations for RTL (the self-order app has no locale file) and NEED NATIVE REVIEW; RTL is a kit extension.
